name: Mafuyu Gaiden
source:
Mafuyu needs to spend a week in the village where relatives live, away from her lover. Strange and dubious stalkers spy after her there. She needs to contain herself to return to her true love after this week.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
